enabled.description: Whether to generate DNS configuration lines. Set to false to leave resolv.conf to dynamic tools or other managers.

nameservers.description: List of IPv4/IPv6 nameserver addresses to include in resolv.conf.

search_domain.description: A single search domain. If provided alongside search_domains, this is included in the search list.

search_domains.description: Additional search domains to append to the search directive.

domain.description: The local hostname domain name. If provided, a 'domain' directive is written instead of (or in addition to) search.
